economic_impact.status_label: Rapid sectoral assessment ongoing; no official monetary loss estimate available

known_impacts.status: 200 BTS/sites disrupted across 10 districts/cities involving three operators; restoration monitored by Komdigi.
Damage reported at Laurentius Say Port, Reo Port, Nangakeo Port and Komodo Airport.
Pioneer service at Nangakeo Port temporarily suspended; Komodo Airport continued operating normally with restrictions.
Landslides and rockfall disrupted several routes; consolidated road-damage and reopening status remain under assessment.
known_impacts.confidence: BNPB and forwarded Basarnas field reporting

known_impacts.status: Power outage was reported in Nagekeo earlier in the response; the current extent and restoration status were not available.
One Bulog warehouse was reported affected; operational and stock-loss details remain under verification.
